functions.name: MATCH
functions.description: Runs VM0047 Global Optimal Bipartite k-NN Matching without replacement and spills the sorted match ledger.

parameters.name: projectTable
parameters.description: Project Plots range including header row (Column 1 = Plot_ID, Columns 2+ = Coordinates/Covariates)

parameters.name: controlTable
parameters.description: Control Plots range including header row (Column 1 = Control_ID, Columns 2+ = Coordinates/Covariates)

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: Number of nearest neighbor control plots per project plot (5 or 7). Default is 5.
